headline: Genki’s new customizable controller has a big screen and adjustable buttons
summary: Genki launched the Manta, its first custom-designed controller. It features an unorthodox design with a large 2.9-inch LCD screen. The controller offers customizable thumbsticks and buttons for a personalized experience.

headline: Google Discover is getting an AI chatbot-tuned feed
summary: Google Discover will soon allow users to customize their feed using AI. Describe desired content, and the AI will adapt the feed automatically. The feature will remember preferences for future visits.

headline: Riot is ending development on its League of Legends fighting game
summary: Riot Games is winding down development on 2XKO, its free-to-play League of Legends fighting game. The company cites insufficient player retention for sustainability. Active development concludes at the end of 2026.

headline: The Genesis GV90 blows the bloody doors off what’s possible in EV design
summary: Genesis unveiled the GV90, its first full-size, three-row electric SUV. It boasts 'wild' designs and features, including distinctive coach-style doors. The GV90 aims to redefine luxury EV possibilities.

headline: Netflix Reveals New Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Trailer and Images at Anime NYC
summary: Netflix unveiled a new trailer and images for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. The reveal happened at Anime NYC, showcasing more high-octane action. Fans can expect continued intense storytelling from Night City.

headline: Netflix Confirms Blue Eye Samurai Will End With Third and Final Season
summary: Netflix has officially announced that Blue Eye Samurai will conclude. The popular series will end with its upcoming third season. This marks the planned finale for the acclaimed anime.

headline: Netflix Reveals Packed Anime Slate: Full Announcement Rundown, Trailers, and Images
summary: Netflix showcased a massive lineup of upcoming anime projects at Anime NYC. Exclusive trailers and images were revealed for several series. Highlights included Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 and The One Piece.

headline: Double Your PlayStation 5 Storage With This 1TB PCIe M.2 SSD for Just $136.39 Shipped
summary: An essential upgrade for PlayStation 5 owners is on sale. Get a 1TB PCIe M.2 SSD for only $136.39, including shipping. This deal allows users to double their PS5 storage capacity affordably.

headline: El Niño weather system set to be 'strongest in living memory', warns Met Office
summary: The Met Office warns that the El Niño weather system will be 'strongest in living memory.' Scientists call the growing pattern an 'unprecedented event.' 2027 is predicted to be the world's hottest year on record.

headline: Harry and Meghan's return to UK reignites questions over security
summary: Harry and Meghan's surprise UK return sparks security debates. A new decision is needed on their entitlement to publicly funded protection. The Duke and Duchess's security has been a past point of contention.

headline: Watch: What does Harry's return mean for his fractured relationship with William?
summary: Prince Harry's return to the UK raises questions about his relationship with Prince William. The brothers have experienced a fractured relationship for several years. Royal watchers speculate on potential reconciliation or further strain.

headline: French becoming more effective in stopping small boat crossings, UK says
summary: The UK Home Office reports France is more effective in stopping small boat crossings. France has intercepted hundreds of potential crossings this summer. New tactics are credited for the increased success rate.
